An ordinary throttle. Retryable, and the Retry-After header the live response
carries is NOT recorded here — headers are not part of what a fixture may
contain, and the header's handling is exercised against the misbehaving server
in errors_test.go, where both RFC 9110 forms can be driven deterministically.

Contrast the spend-cap 429, which carries the same status and error type,
no Retry-After, and details.error_code "enforced_spend_limit_reached" — and
which never clears within a run.
